design_philosophy: A visually inspiring, calm, and structured travel planner. Using generous spacing to let destination imagery shine and clean bento grids for itinerary details.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with Bento Grids
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-8, p-12 for sections. Cards have p-6 inner padding.
layout_and_spacing.container_radius: rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-3xl for main imagery
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB on cards, no heavy shadows. Subtle drop-shadow-sm.
layout_and_spacing.grid_pattern: Bento grids for dashboard. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with varied spans.

components.buttons: Rounded-full, solid primary bg for CTAs, clear hover states with slightly darker background and transform translate-y-[-2px].
components.cards: Flat background with 1px border. Never heavy shadows. Hover lifts slightly.
components.forms: Shadcn/UI inputs with customized rounded borders (rounded-xl) and soft focus rings.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with z-50.
components.images: Hero max-h-[80vh], object-cover. Use black/30 overlay if text is over it.

motion.page_load: staggered fade-up for list items (itinerary days)
motion.micro_interactions: scale-105 on image hover within cards

hero_image.description: Beautiful coastal road trip, hero background

friends_travel.description: Friends travelling together, for preferences section

map_placeholder.description: Abstract topographic map, for background elements

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.test_ids: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the landing page using custom Tailwind and raw HTML tags. Add smooth scrolling.
Use Shadcn UI for the dashboard, form, and trips list, but override their default styles to match the rounded-2xl, soft bento-grid feel.
Implement the 'Day-by-Day' itinerary view as a vertically stacked bento list. Each day contains horizontal scrolling or grid cards for places and hotels.
Make sure every 'Place' and 'Hotel' card includes an image, title, description, and an explicit 'Open in Google Maps' button (which can just be a link with target _blank).
Provide a photo gallery component inside the trip detail page using a masonry or standard grid layout.
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Make sure to import them via Google Fonts.
Ensure all buttons, links, and forms have data-testid attributes.
